title: Research: restored decoder stars save 128 R420 XORs (no new kappa)
head: 2b30b63789f6d9948233fc67d9d79bca6b185c5b
body:
This **finite bit-circuit construction** replaces disjoint pair sharing with eleven restored helper stars in the nine FULL-frame decoder totals of eumemic's selected PR543 R420 word. The decoder costs **321 -> 257 binary XORs**, including all preparation/restoration; literal reverse cleanup doubles the saving to **128 native ADDs: 26,916 -> 26,788**. **No new kappa is claimed.**

The complete phase-A operator on arbitrary dirty inputs is unchanged. D compensation, every register frame path, 420 helpers, nine copies, rank mass 5,112 and the original H1-H5 interface are preserved. Positive growth is recomputed: native nine-stage payload rises from **100 to 103 bits**, still strictly below 104.

PR708 at `2ec522a466ec448f148d4355dc43b51c0ef1e0b5` is the immediate predecessor. This saves 14 additional native ADDs over its frozen pair recipe. The three-register witness `[515,489,347]` saves four ADDs with a star; any disjoint-pair recipe restricted to those registers saves at most two. This distinguishes the search class without claiming global optimality.

Base: `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60`. Reviewed PR543 source: `2065fe4f72a914d907f1046603f5a36f17018535`. Only `research/r420-decoder-bundles/` is added. Source pins, exact recipe/certificate, proof, independent interpreter, native runner, receipts and attribution are included.

```sh
python3 -B research/r420-decoder-bundles/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_R420_DECODER_BUNDLES decoder=321->257 native_ADDs=26916->26788 saved=128 columns=660 controls=8 no_new_kappa`.

Validation passed locally on macOS with Python 3.14.8, GCC 16.2.0 and Boost 1.85.0:

- Original E8/frame/interface checker and all 660 arbitrary-input columns; separate set-valued replay of the entire A operator, complete word and inverse, frame paths and paid invoice.
- Fresh unchanged C++ legality and nine-stage replay for both words: 1,380 formal columns, 18/18 omitted-bridge controls each, nine COPY/ERASE lifecycles. Records fall 29,874 -> 29,746.
- Eight circuit/interface/source controls, canonical native-input rejection, explicit optimized-Python refusal and altered search-metadata rejection.
- Exact certificate comparison, relocated minimal Git archive replay, selected-record binding and staged whitespace checks. Separate AI review's metadata-binding and wording findings were fixed.

Assignment seed **19**, drawn once from OS randomness. All 6,320 oriented edges on 80 operands were scored; one seeded greedy star packing selected 44 edges. Stop rule: no positive edge remains on unused operands. No restarts or optimality claim. No pinned coordination issue existed, so the claim is local.

Final overlap refresh through #751 found Chinmay Khaladkar's distinct source-coset construction #748, head `0ccc0b425d2b9667108d3a0918a5cfa0aa7a5861`, with larger 244-ADD savings. It changes the helper-dirt map and recomputes D; this contribution preserves the full A operator and D and adds fresh C++ multistage evidence. PR733 and PR742 also have larger savings in D. No overall record or composition with concurrent work is claimed.

The full hosted-parent/global invoice, changed-word outer assembly, repository-wide suite, selected cold replay, Lean and remote CI were not run. Inherited all-size/compiler/common-label/mutable-basis/hosting/residual/precision/tape/analytic assumptions remain. This is not a full multiplication proof or measured runtime speedup. The selected frontier and `upstream/` are unchanged.

Prepared for **Sagar Thakrar (@thakrarsagar)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance**, including separate workers for mathematical review, independent interpretation and native replay, under Apache-2.0. Credit remains with eumemic, Dylan Crow, DreamingOfClouds, Zhihao Chen and the predecessor lineage. PR708's native wrapper is adapted with explicit attribution. No independent human review is claimed.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
